notes.title: 🟨Patch 0.2.2 incorporating user feedback🟨
notes.notes:
Fixed an error that occurred when the inventory was full.

Added Savannah NPC.



Added full inventory notification.

Added material pickup reaction.

Adjusted furniture interaction button position.

notes.title: 🟨Patch 0.2.1 incorporating user feedback🟨
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when obtaining materials while the inventory was open.

Fixed an issue where certain types of mats would not appear in the campsite.

Fixed an issue where the discovery status in the book would not update after loading.



Rainbow stones have appeared around Barista Rabbit's cafe.

notes.title: 🟨Patch 0.2.0 incorporating user feedback🟨
notes.notes:
The number of materials required to craft certain furniture and items has been reduced.

Some systems have been optimized.



Rocks and iron ore have been added around the campsite.



All materials required for furniture crafting can now be identified by color.

notes.title: 🟨WallPaper and Flooring Update! Patch 0.1.9🟨
notes.notes:
Collecting materials has become easier.

The number of materials required to craft specific furniture and items has been changed.



Two types of wallpaper and flooring have been added.



Some images have been modified.

notes.title: 🟨Patch 0.1.8 incorporating user feedback🟨
notes.notes:
The number of materials required to craft certain furniture and items has been reduced.



Cotton trees, which yield old fabric, have been added.



Fixed a minimap error.

Fixed the ESC menu on the start screen.

Fixed other UI-related errors.

notes.title: 🟨Patch 0.1.7 incorporating user feedback🟨
notes.notes:
Start conversations with NPCs using the F key.

Conversations can also be conducted by left-clicking the mouse.

NPC and Player Collision Fix.

Reduced player attack range.


   
ESC menu UI changes.

Mouse cursor color changes.
